=== py
import os
from typing import Optional

class Report:
    """A report, with a docstring."""
    LIMIT = 10

    def __init__(self, name: str, rows: Optional[list] = None):
        self.name = name  # trailing comment
        self.rows = rows or []

    @property
    def title(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name!r} ({len(self.rows)} rows)"

async def main():
    for i, r in enumerate(range(3)):
        print(i, r, 0x1f, 1.5e3, b"bytes", r'raw\n')
=== go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// Greeter says hello.
type Greeter struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (g *Greeter) Greet(times int) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for i := 0; i < times; i++ {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "hello %s %d\n", g.Name, i)
	}
	return b.String() + `raw ` + string('x')
}

func main() { _ = (&Greeter{Name: "e"}).Greet(3) }
=== c
#include <stdio.h>
#define MAX(a, b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))

/* A block
   comment. */
typedef struct { int x; const char *name; } point;

static int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

int main(void) {
    point p = { .x = 3, .name = "origin" };
    printf("%d %s %c\n", MAX(p.x, add(1, 2)), p.name, 'q');
    return 0;
}
